title: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007
titleHi: माता-पिता और वरिष्ठ नागरिकों का भरण-पोषण तथा कल्याण अधिनियम, 2007

sourceNote: Official India Code. The Act provides the statutory framework for maintenance of parents/senior citizens and welfare measures including old-age homes.

title: UP Scholarship — Revised Schedule for Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship, 2025-26
titleHi: उत्तर प्रदेश छात्रवृत्ति — पूर्वदशम एवं दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति हेतु संशोधित समय-सारिणी, 2025-26
sourceNote: Official Government of Uttar Pradesh. The Department's official press release identifies Government Order No. 161/2025/2720/26-3-2025-1396097 dated 06 October 2025 and states that the revised schedule applies to 2025-26 pre-matric (classes 9-10) and post-matric (classes 11-12) scholarship schemes.
